programs.title: Legacy List With Matt Paxton
programs.desc: The Taos, New Mexico adobe where Marcia's grandparents once lived has sat empty for years. The outside is weathered and heirlooms and antiques inside have gone untouched. Now Marcia - an attorney who was the first Mexican-American woman to graduate from Princeton - and her family want to make the historic adobe livable again. They call on Matt and his team to help preserve their family legacy.
